'''Bantha Squad''' was a special unit of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that was formed by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in response to significant challenges presented by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|Hailfire droids]].

==History==
Bantha [[Squad/Legends|Squad]] was quickly established by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as a response to the destruction of entire [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] in the [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] Army. Assigned to specifically target [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|''Hailfire''-class]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] tanks, Bantha Squad included specialists in heavy weapons, aerial recon and demolitions. With these combined skills, the squad was capable of pinpointing and attacking Hailfire droids with the firepower needed to immobilize and demolish them in any assault operation.<ref name="Hasbro" />

[[File:BanthaSquadTankGunnerCommander.jpg|thumb|left|Bantha Squad's tank gunner commander]]
The [[Clone gunner/Legends|tank gunner]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]] of Bantha Squad was an expert in the use and application of heavy weapons and demolitions, uniquely qualifying him to formulate successful strategies against Hailfire droids. The troopers under his command used a modified version of the [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|A6 Juggernaut turbo tank]]{{'s}} [[Heavy repeating cannon|heavy repeating]] [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] to bombard Hailfire droids with weapons fire before a final application of explosives.<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Equipment==
===Armor===
[[File:BanthaSquadAerialReconTrooper.jpg|thumb|right|Bantha Squad aerial recon trooper (right) with macrobinoculars raised]]
Bantha Squad clones were outfitted in white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I armor]], with light- and dark-green designs to mark their squad affiliation. The commander wore extra plating on his helmet and body armor, and a [[Kama/Legends|kama]] for anti-blast protection against crippling injury as well as to signify his rank.<ref name="Hasbro" />

In addition to [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]], aerial recon troopers wore [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] on their helmets and carried special communications equipment to relay key tactical information.<ref name="Hasbro" />

===Kit===
[[File:BanthaSquadCloneTrooper.jpg|thumb|left|A Bantha Squad trooper with DC-15A blaster rifle]]
Bantha soldiers were issued the standard [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]], with the more compact counterpart&mdash;the [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] blaster carbine&mdash;assigned to the aerial recon trooper. Jetpacks featured built-in [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]], which cause devastating blasts against enemy units. The squad's clones were each equipped with [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belts]], with the addition of holsters for the commander, who sported a pair of customized [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]].<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:HAVwA6Juggernaut-FFp41.png|thumb|right|250px|A HAVw A6 Juggernaut with what could possibly be the emblem of Bantha Squad]]
In [[August]] [[2010]], [[Hasbro]] released the ''Anti-Hailfire Droid Squad Battle Pack'' as part of their ''Shadow of the Dark Side'' toy line to introduce [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|Season 3]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]]. On the Game cards, the pictures of the troopers are modified pictures of various clone troopers. The two Clone Troopers, Aerial Recon Trooper and Clone Commander figures came with weapon accessories and 4 Galactic Battle Game cards 4 battle bases and 1 game die.<ref name="Hasbro" />
